name: ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute + ec2:StopInstances + ec2:StartInstances
description: Inject a malicious cloud-init script into an existing EC2 instance's userData to execute code under the instance's attached IAM role. The instance must be stopped before the attribute can be modified; the malicious script runs on the next boot. Uses the cloud-init multipart MIME format with cloud_final_modules to force execution on every subsequent boot rather than only the first.
author: Seth Art
